prompt: Review the outgoing change at HEAD against HEAD^ in evals/files/projection-unruled-review using the installed dsh-spec-code-review skill. Read the project rules and inspect the actual diff. Assess ownership, state size, historical reads, and migration behavior without importing defaults from another project. Record rule-dependent review as a gap rather than treating it as passed. Do not modify files or Git state.
expected_output: The review records that the project declares no state-persistence, projection, or recovery rules, so rule-specific ownership, state size, historical-read, and migration assessment remains an explicit review gap. It may report observable runtime defects, but it does not apply another project's fixed-size, version, checkpoint, or migration defaults or present the rule-dependent review as complete.
assertions: The review reports that the project declares no projection or recovery rules.
The review records the projection review as an explicit gap.
The review does not import another project's bounds, version, checkpoint, or migration defaults.
The review does not present the rule-dependent projection review as complete.
